title: An ACP agent's catch-up reads a rich text by its plain text and a composite by its text part, and nothing of a location or a template: a message holding only one is left out
notes: Four messages address no one, so coder receives none of them: a rich text, a location, a template, and a composite of a text and a location. Its next prompt's catch-up reads them as text outside the channel: the rich text by its plain text, the composite's text part alone, and nothing of the location and the template, so the catch-up counts two messages. A media's label and a composite's parts in order are shown by acp/a-catch-up-reads-each-message-by-its-text-form; a memory's summary, the one reader that reads a location and a template, by memory/a-summary-reads-a-location-and-a-template-by-their-text-form. Python and roomkit-rs read such a message by its content text, which holds a text, a rich text, a media's label and a composite's parts, and nothing of another content. Not observed: the other readers outside a channel (a delegated task's brief, a speak classifier, a discussion's dispatch and notes, a scoring query).
